# ProcurePilot AI

> An interactive, simulated procurement workflow demo and open-source engineering portfolio. This public site does not expose a live Laravel API, live supplier data, payments, MCP services or autonomous purchasing actions.

The public demo runs React/TypeScript in Vercel; its purchase requests, supplier quotes, approvals and invoice examples are browser-local synthetic records. Access to a live tenant database is not provided by this site.

## Pages

- [Interactive demo](https://procurepilot-ai-nine.vercel.app/): landing/login and browser-local workspace.
- [Engineering overview](https://procurepilot-ai-nine.vercel.app/engineering): publicly accessible source-based architecture summary.

## Technical documentation

- [GitHub README](https://github.com/Will-ammari/procurepilot-ai#readme): purpose, setup, scope and known limitations.
- [Engineering case study](https://github.com/Will-ammari/procurepilot-ai/blob/main/docs/engineering-case-study.md): outbox, idempotency, row locking, tenant isolation and trade-offs.
- [Performance evidence](https://github.com/Will-ammari/procurepilot-ai/blob/main/docs/performance-lighthouse.md): PageSpeed scores and their limitations.
- [API contract](https://github.com/Will-ammari/procurepilot-ai/blob/main/docs/openapi.yaml): backend specification; the API is not available on the public Vercel domain.

## Usage boundaries

No real user, customer or supplier data is supplied by this demo. Demo role changes are not backend authorization, and the FastAPI mock/fallback does not represent a measured trained AI model.
